title: Fasaha da al'umma
description: Ten stories of new technology in everyday life: a goalkeeper facing a penalty given by the video referee, a grandson who fixes his grandmother's rusty plug while her puppy overturns the tray, a village midwife who consults a doctor by video call, a betrothal threatened by a copied photo on social media, an old smith who mends a museum's chain mail while a young engineer films it for the internet, almajiri boys learning on a tablet, an imam who warns against a sorcerer selling charms on the internet, soldiers clearing landmines with a camera drone so villagers can go home, a drunk driver caught by a street camera in Accra, and a farmer who harvests between two storms with a weather app.

lessons.title: Fenariti a filin wasa
lessons.summary: Khamis, the goalkeeper of the Kano team in his purple shirt, faces a penalty the referee gives after watching the new video screen; fans shout heated words and try to disrupt the match; Khamis saves the kick, and the next day the radio debates the new technology.
lessons.text:
Khamis shi ne golan ƙungiyar ƙwallon ƙafa ta Kano. Tun yana yaro yake son buga tamaula a titin unguwarsu, kuma yanzu yana da shekara ashirin da huɗu. Rigarsa launin shunayya ce, domin golan ƙungiya yana sa riga daban da ta sauran 'yan wasa. Abokansa suna kiransa "golan shunayya".

A ranar Asabar ƙungiyar Kano za ta buga wasa da ƙungiyar Kaduna. A bana hukumar ƙwallon ƙafa ta kawo sabuwar fasaha a filayen wasa: kyamara da wani allo da ke taimaka wa alƙalin wasa. Idan alƙali bai ga abin da ya faru sosai ba, zai iya tsayar da wasa, ya je ya kalli bidiyon, sannan ya yanke hukunci.

Saleh, abokin Khamis, ya isa filin wasa tun da wuri. Ya ga cincirindon magoya baya a ƙofar shiga. Wasu suna rawa, wasu suna waƙa, wasu kuma suna sayar da ruwa da gyaɗa. Saleh ya ce a ransa, "Ban taɓa ganin cincirindo irin wannan ba."

Wasan ya fara. Kocin Kano yana tsaye a gefen fili, yana taunar cingam da sauri. Kowa ya san cewa idan kocin yana taunar cingam haka, hankalinsa ba ya kwance. Har zuwa minti tamanin ba a ci ƙwallo ba.

A minti tamanin da biyu, wani ɗan wasan Kaduna ya shiga gaban raga, sai ya faɗi. Alƙalin wasa bai yanke hukunci nan da nan ba. Ya je gefen fili ya kalli allon bidiyon. Bayan minti biyu ya dawo, ya nuna wurin bugun fenariti. Bidiyon ya nuna cewa ɗan wasan Kano ya taka ƙafar ɗan wasan Kaduna.

Sai cincirindon magoya bayan Kano suka fara zafafan kalamai. Wasu suna cewa, "Wannan na'ura ta Kaduna ce!" Wasu kuma suka jefa robobin ruwa cikin fili domin su hargitsa wasan. 'Yan sanda suka shiga cikin jama'a suka kwantar da hankali. Kyaftin ɗin Kano ya ɗaga hannu yana roƙon magoya baya kada su hargitsa wasan, domin idan aka hargitsa shi, za a hukunta ƙungiyarsu.

Khamis ya tsaya a tsakiyar raga da rigarsa ta shunayya. Ya kalli ɗan wasan da zai buga fenariti a ido. Ɗan wasan ya buga ƙwallon zuwa gefen hagu. Khamis ya yi tsalle, ya kama ta da hannu biyu! Cincirindon ya yi ihu har ƙasa ta girgiza. Kocin ya jefar da cingam ɗinsa, ya yi dariya.

Wasan ya ƙare babu ci. Washegari a rediyo aka yi ta musayar zafafan kalamai game da sabuwar fasahar. Wani mai sharhi ya ce, "Na'urar ba ta yi kuskure ba. Fenariti ce ta gaskiya." Wani kuma ya ce, "Fasahar tana da amfani, amma tana rage daɗin tamaula." Saleh ya kira Khamis a waya ya ce, "Na'urar ta ba su fenariti, amma golan Kano ya hana su ci! Wannan ita ce tamaula ta gaske."

Tambayoyi:
Wane ne golan ƙungiyar Kano?
Khamis ne golan ƙungiyar Kano.
Wane launi ne rigar Khamis?
Rigar Khamis launin shunayya ce.
Me ya sa alƙalin wasa ya ba da bugun fenariti?
Domin bidiyon ya nuna cewa ɗan wasan Kano ya taka ƙafar ɗan wasan Kaduna.
Me wasu magoya baya suka yi domin su hargitsa wasan?
Sun jefa robobin ruwa cikin fili.
Me Khamis ya yi da ƙwallon fenariti?
Ya yi tsalle, ya kama ta da hannu biyu.
Me magoya bayan Kano suka fara yi bayan an ba da fenariti?
Sun fara zafafan kalamai.

lessons.title: Filogin kaka
lessons.summary: Mahir visits his grandmother in Zaria; her fan has stopped because its old plug has rusted; he buys a new plug, cuts the wire and fixes it while her puppy tries to chew the wire, then the puppy overturns the tray of chin-chin, and in the evening the town's power is cut as usual.
lessons.text:
A lokacin hutun makaranta, Mahir ya je gidan kakarsa a Zaria. Kakarsa tana zaune ita kaɗai tare da wani ƙaramin kwikwiyo da maƙwabciyarta ta ba ta kyauta. Kwikwiyon fari ne, kuma yana son wasa da duk abin da ya gani a ƙasa.

Da Mahir ya isa, kakarsa ta kawo masa tire cike da cincin. Ta ce, "Na soya maka cincin jiya, domin na san kana son sa." Ta ajiye tiren a kan ƙaramin tebur. Mahir ya ci cincin guda uku, sannan ya tambaye ta labarin gidan.

Kakarsa ta ce, "Mahir, fankata ba ta aiki tun makon jiya. Na zaci an datse wutar lantarki ne, amma maƙwabta suna da wuta." Mahir ya duba fankar. Ya ga filogin ya tsufa, kuma ƙarfen da ke cikinsa ya yi tsatsa saboda danshin damina. Ya ce, "Kaka, filogi ne matsalar. Tsatsa ta hana wuta ta wuce."

Mahir ya tafi kasuwa ya sayi sabon filogi. Da ya dawo, ya kashe wutar gidan baki ɗaya kafin ya taɓa wayoyin. Ya datse wayar daga tsohon filogin da almakashi, ya goge tsatsar da ke jikin wayoyin, sannan ya ɗaura su a cikin sabon filogin.

Yana cikin aiki, sai kwikwiyon ya zo ya kama wayar da haƙoransa. Mahir ya ce, "A'a! Wannan ba abin wasa ba ne!" Ya ɗauke shi ya kai shi wurin kakarsa. Kakarsa ta ce, "Wannan kwikwiyo ba shi da hankali. Jiya ma ya kusa cizon wayar talabijin."

Mahir ya gama, ya sa filogin a bango, ya kunna wuta. Fankar ta fara juyawa. Kakarsa ta yi murna sosai. Ta ce, "Ashe ilimin zamani yana da amfani! Ni da na zaci sai na sayi sabuwar fanka."

A lokacin, kwikwiyon ya ga tiren cincin a kan tebur. Ya yi tsalle, ya kifa tiren a ƙasa. Cincin ya watse ko'ina, kwikwiyon ya fara ci da sauri. Mahir da kakarsa suka yi dariya. Kakarsa ta ce, "Kai ka gyara filogi, shi kuma ya kifa mini tire!" Mahir ya ɗauki tiren, ya tara sauran cincin, ya ajiye su a sama inda kwikwiyon ba zai kai ba.

Da dare aka datse wutar lantarki a unguwar baki ɗaya, kamar yadda ake yi kusan kowane dare. Fankar ta tsaya. Kakarsa ta yi murmushi ta ce, "Ka ga, yanzu ba laifin filogi ba ne." Suka fito tsakar gida, suka zauna suna hira a cikin iska, kwikwiyon yana barci a ƙafafunsu.

Tambayoyi:
Me kakar Mahir ta kawo masa a kan tire?
Ta kawo masa cincin a kan tire.
Me ya sa fankar kakarsa ba ta aiki?
Domin filogin ya tsufa, kuma ƙarfensa ya yi tsatsa.
Da me Mahir ya datse wayar daga tsohon filogin?
Ya datse ta da almakashi.
Me kwikwiyon ya yi da tiren cincin?
Ya kifa tiren a ƙasa, ya fara cin cincin.
Me ya sa fankar ta tsaya da dare?
Domin an datse wutar lantarki a unguwar baki ɗaya.

lessons.title: Ungozoma da waya
lessons.summary: Kubura, a village midwife near Katsina, has been given a phone for video calls with doctors; she warns villagers against open defecation and dirty rags, sends a doctor a picture of the swelling in pregnant Mamuna's feet, and the doctor sends Mamuna to hospital in time; the doctor also helps with Mamuna's son's asthma.
lessons.text:
Kubura ungozoma ce a wani ƙauye kusa da Katsina. Ta shafe shekara talatin tana taimaka wa mata wajen haihuwa. Babu likita a ƙauyen, kuma asibiti mafi kusa yana da nisan kilomita arba'in. A bara wata ƙungiya ta ba kowace ungozoma a yankin wayar hannu, ta koya musu yadda za su yi magana da likitocin asibiti ta bidiyo.

Kubura ba ta tsaya a kan haihuwa kaɗai ba. Takan tara mutanen ƙauyen a ƙarƙashin bishiya, ta yi musu wa'azi game da tsabta. Takan ce, "Kada ku yi bahaya a fili ko a bakin rafi. Bahaya a fili yana kawo cututtuka ga yara." Ta kuma gaya wa mata, "Idan za a haihu, kada a yi amfani da tsumma mai datti. Tsumma mai datti yana kawo ciwo ga uwa da jariri. A yi amfani da zane mai tsabta."

Wata rana Mamuna, wata mace mai ciki wata takwas, ta zo gidan Kubura. Ta ce, "Ungozoma, ƙafafuna sun kumbura, kuma ina yawan fitsari." Kubura ta duba ta. Kumburin ƙafafunta ya yi yawa, har yatsunta ba sa shiga takalma. Kubura ta ce, "Ba zan yi wasa da wannan kumburi ba."

Ta ɗauki wayarta, ta kira wani likita a Katsina ta bidiyo. Ta nuna masa kumburin ƙafafun Mamuna, ta gaya masa matsalar mafitsararta. Likitan ya ce, "Yawan fitsari a lokacin ciki ba abin tsoro ba ne, domin jariri yana matse mafitsara. Idan fitsarin yana yi miki zafi, to ciwon mafitsara ne, sai a sha magani. Amma wannan kumburi yana iya zama alamar hawan jini. A kawo ta asibiti yau."

Kubura ta nemi mota, ta raka Mamuna zuwa Katsina. A asibitin aka gano cewa jininta ya hau sosai. Likitoci suka ba ta magani, kuma bayan kwana uku ta haifi ɗa namiji lafiya.

Kafin su koma, Mamuna ta gaya wa likitan cewa ɗanta na farko yana da asma. Duk lokacin da ƙura ta tashi, yaron yakan yi atishawa sau da yawa, sannan numfashinsa ya yi wuya. Likitan ya ce, "Ƙura da hayaƙin itace suna tayar da asma. Atishawa tana iya zama farkonta." Ya ba ta maganin asma da ake shaƙa, ya ce, "Idan atishawa ta fara, ku kai shi wuri mai iska mai tsabta."

Da suka dawo ƙauye, Mamuna ta ce wa Kubura, "Da ba don wayarki ba, da ban san abin da zai faru ba." Kubura ta yi murmushi, ta ce, "Wayar kayan aiki ce kawai. Ilimin ungozoma da na likita ne suka haɗu."

Tambayoyi:
Ina Kubura take aiki?
Tana aiki a matsayin ungozoma a wani ƙauye kusa da Katsina.
Me ya sa Kubura take hana mutane yin bahaya a fili?
Domin bahaya a fili yana kawo cututtuka ga yara.
Me ya sa ba a so a yi amfani da tsumma mai datti wajen haihuwa?
Domin tsumma mai datti yana kawo ciwo ga uwa da jariri.
Me likitan ya ce game da kumburin ƙafafun Mamuna?
Ya ce kumburin yana iya zama alamar hawan jini, a kawo ta asibiti.
Me yake tayar da asmar ɗan Mamuna?
Ƙura da hayaƙin itace suna tayar da ita.

lessons.title: Hoton da aka kwafe
lessons.summary: Jalal is courting Humaira and their betrothal is near; her rival Rumana copies Humaira's photos, posts them with mocking words to disgrace her and pushes printed copies under neighbours' doors; Humaira tears up the copies, the page deletes the post, Rumana apologises, and the betrothal goes ahead.
lessons.text:
Jalal da Humaira sun haɗu a jami'a a Kano. Bayan sun gama karatu, Jalal ya fara zawarcin Humaira. Yakan je gidansu da yamma, ya zauna da ita a ƙofar gida, suna hira a gaban 'yan uwanta. Zawarcinsu ya yi kyau, kuma iyayensu duka sun ji daɗi.

Da dare kuma sukan yi wa juna saƙo a waya. Humaira takan fara saƙonta da "Ya ƙaunataccena Jalal". Jalal yana son wannan magana sosai. Wata rana ya ce mata, "Duk lokacin da na ga 'ƙaunataccena' a wayata, sai in yi murmushi."

Daga ƙarshe iyayen Jalal suka je gidan iyayen Humaira, suka nemi aurenta. Aka sa ranar baiko a watan gaba. Kowa ya fara shirin baikon: mata suna shirya kaya, maza suna shirya abinci.

Amma akwai wata yarinya a unguwar, Rumana, wadda ta daɗe tana son Jalal. Da ta ji labarin baikon, sai kishi ya kama ta. Ta shiga shafin Humaira na sada zumunta, ta kwafe hotunanta guda biyar. Sannan ta buɗe wani sabon shafi da sunan ƙarya, ta sa hotunan da ta kwafe, ta rubuta kalaman tsokana a ƙarƙashinsu: "Ga wadda za ta yi baiko! Ku dubi fuskarta, ku ga ko ta cancanci aure."

Rumana ba ta tsaya a nan ba. Ta buga hotunan a takarda, ta riƙa saka su a ƙarƙashin ƙofofin maƙwabta. Burinta shi ne ta tozarta Humaira a idon jama'a, ta sa iyayen Jalal su fasa baikon.

Da safe mahaifiyar Humaira ta tsinci ɗaya daga cikin takardun a ƙofar gida. Humaira ta karanta kalaman tsokanar, hawaye suka zubo mata. Sannan ta yi ƙarfin hali, ta yayyaga takardar. Ta je ta tara sauran takardun da ke unguwar, ita ma ta yayyaga su duka.

Ta kira Jalal ta gaya masa. Jalal ya ce, "Ki kwantar da hankalinki. Babu wanda zai iya tozarta ki a idona. Ni na san ke." Suka kai rahoto ga masu kula da shafin sada zumuntar, kuma aka goge rubutun a ranar. 'Yan uwan Humaira suka bi diddigi, suka gano cewa Rumana ce ta kwafe hotunan.

Mahaifin Rumana ya ji kunya ƙwarai. Ya kawo ta gidan Humaira, ta nemi gafara a gaban kowa. Humaira ta yafe mata, amma ta ce, "Ki sani, tsokana ba ta gina komai, sai dai ta rushe." An yi baikon a ranar da aka sa, kuma Humaira ta aika wa Jalal saƙo a wannan dare: "Ya ƙaunataccena, yau na fi kowa farin ciki."

Tambayoyi:
Yaya zawarcin Jalal da Humaira yake?
Jalal yakan je gidansu da yamma, ya zauna da ita a gaban 'yan uwanta.
Yaya Humaira take fara saƙonninta ga Jalal?
Takan fara su da "Ya ƙaunataccena Jalal".
Me Rumana ta yi da hotunan Humaira?
Ta kwafe su, ta sa su a wani shafi da sunan ƙarya, ta rubuta kalaman tsokana a ƙarƙashinsu.
Me Rumana take so ta yi wa Humaira?
Tana so ta tozarta ta a idon jama'a.
Me Humaira ta yi da takardun?
Ta yayyaga su duka.
Me ya faru da baikon?
An yi baikon a ranar da aka sa.

lessons.title: Sulke a gidan tarihi
lessons.summary: Babangida, a young engineer, is photographing the objects of a Kano museum near the old city wall for a website; an old chain-mail coat has fallen apart, so he brings it to Malam Muhyiddeen, a smith proud of his line of smiths who once smelted iron ore, who mends it in his smithy; the video of the work goes round the world.
lessons.text:
Babangida injiniya ne matashi a Kano. Wani gidan tarihi da ke kusa da garun Kano ya ɗauke shi aiki: zai ɗauki hoton kowane abu da ke cikin gidan tarihin, ya sa su a yanar gizo domin mutanen duniya su gani. Garun Kano an gina shi tun zamanin da domin kare birnin daga abokan gaba. Yau garun ya tsufa, wani wuri ya rushe, amma mutane suna alfahari da shi.

A cikin gidan tarihin akwai kayan mayaƙan zamanin da: takubba, garkuwoyi, da wani tsohon sulke. Sulke kayan yaƙi ne da aka yi da ƙananan zobban ƙarfe, ana sa shi a ƙarƙashin babbar riga domin kariya daga takobi. A kusa da sulken akwai wani babban rawani na wani tsohon sarki. Mahayan sarki sukan naɗa rawani a kansu, su sa sulke a jikinsu, kafin su tafi yaƙi.

Da Babangida ya zo ɗaukar hoton sulken, sai ya ga wasu zobba sun karye, sulken ya fara watsewa. Shugaban gidan tarihin ya ce, "Ba mu san wanda zai iya gyara shi ba. Maƙera na zamani ba su san wannan aiki ba." Babangida ya ce, "Na san wani tsoho a cikin birni. Maƙerarsa tana bakin kasuwa."

Washegari Babangida ya je maƙerar Malam Muhyiddeen. Ya same shi zaune a gaban wuta, yana bugun ƙarfe da guduma. Malam Muhyiddeen ya yi masa maraba, ya ce, "Mu tsatson maƙera ne. Ba kowa ne yake da tsatso irin namu ba. Kakan kakana ya yi aiki a wannan maƙera." Ya ci gaba da magana da tutiya: "A wancan zamani ba a sayen ƙarfe a kasuwa. Maƙera ne suke tono tama a ƙasa, su narkar da ita a wuta, sai ƙarfe ya fito. Daga tama ne kakanninmu suka yi takubba da sulke."

Aka kawo sulken maƙerar. Malam Muhyiddeen ya duba shi na tsawon lokaci, sannan ya ce, "Zan gyara shi, amma ba zan yi amfani da sabon ƙarfe ba. Zan yi zobban kamar yadda kakanninmu suka yi." Ya shafe makonni uku yana aiki. Babangida yana zaune kusa da shi, yana ɗaukar bidiyon kowane mataki.

Da aka gama, aka mayar da sulken gidan tarihi, aka ajiye shi kusa da rawanin sarkin. Babangida ya sa bidiyon a yanar gizo, ya rubuta labarin tama, da labarin tsatson maƙeran. A cikin wata guda, mutane fiye da dubu ɗari suka kalli bidiyon, daga Legas, Accra, har ma da London. Wasu gidajen tarihi biyu suka nemi Malam Muhyiddeen ya gyara musu nasu sulke.

Malam Muhyiddeen ya naɗa rawaninsa, ya zauna a gaban maƙerarsa, ya ce da tutiya, "Ashe wayar nan ta fi garu girma! Garu yana kare birni ɗaya ne kawai, ita kuma tana kai sunan maƙera ko'ina a duniya."

Tambayoyi:
Ina gidan tarihin yake?
Yana kusa da garun Kano.
Yaya aka yi sulke?
An yi shi da ƙananan zobban ƙarfe.
Me mahayan sarki sukan yi kafin su tafi yaƙi?
Sukan naɗa rawani a kansu, su sa sulke a jikinsu.
Ta yaya maƙera suke samun ƙarfe a zamanin da?
Sukan tono tama a ƙasa, su narkar da ita a wuta.
Me Babangida yake yi yayin da Malam Muhyiddeen yake aiki?
Yana ɗaukar bidiyon kowane mataki.

lessons.title: Almajirai da kwamfutar hannu
lessons.summary: Bushra, a retired teacher in Yola, brings tablets to an almajiri school whose boys wander the streets begging after dawn lessons; the tablet reads aloud for Hilal, who sees poorly, shows a rhinoceros, and teaches Hausa grammar; by the end of the year Hilal is named the best pupil.
lessons.text:
Malama Bushra ta yi shekara talatin da biyar tana aikin malanta a wata makarantar firamare a Yola. Da ta yi ritaya, ba ta so ta zauna a gida kawai ba. Ta ce, "Malanta ba aiki ba ne kawai, rayuwata ce."

Kusa da gidanta akwai makarantar almajirai. Almajiran sukan tashi tun alfijir, su karanta Alƙur'ani a gaban malaminsu har rana ta fito. Bayan haka, da yawansu sukan yi gararamba a titi suna bara har yamma. Malama Bushra ba ta son ganin yara suna gararamba a cikin rana da ƙura.

Ta je wurin malamin almajiran, ta ce, "Malam, ina so in koya wa yaranka karatun boko da rana, bayan karatunsu na alfijir. Wata ƙungiya ta ba ni kwamfutocin hannu goma." Malamin ya amince, domin shi ma ba ya son yaransa suna gararamba.

A rana ta farko, Malama Bushra ta lura da wani yaro mai suna Hilal. Hilal yana da tawaya a idanunsa: ba ya gani sosai sai idan ya kawo littafi kusa da fuskarsa. Saboda wannan tawaya, wasu yara sukan yi masa dariya. Malama Bushra ta nuna masa yadda kwamfutar hannu take karanta rubutu da babbar murya, da yadda ake ƙara girman haruffa. Hilal ya yi murna ƙwarai. Ya ce, "Malama, yanzu tawayar idona ba za ta hana ni karatu ba."

Malama Bushra ta fara koya musu nahawun Hausa. Ta ce, "Nahawu shi ne tsarin harshe. Idan ka san nahawu, za ka iya rubutu daidai." Ta nuna musu bambancin "ne" da "ce", da yadda ake cewa "babban gida" da "babbar mota". Yaran suka yi ta gasa a kan kwamfutocin, suna amsa tambayoyin nahawu.

Wata rana ta nuna musu bidiyon dabbobin Afirka. Da karkanda ta bayyana a allon, yaran suka yi ihu. Ɗaya ya ce, "Malama, wannan giwa ce?" Ta ce, "A'a, wannan karkanda ce. Karkanda tana da ƙaho a kan hancinta, kuma mafarauta suna kashe ta saboda ƙahon." Hilal ya kawo kwamfutar kusa da idonsa, ya ce, "Karkanda ta fi saniya girma!"

A ƙarshen shekara, aka yi wa almajiran jarrabawa. Hilal ne ya fi kowa ci. Malama Bushra ta ba shi takardar shaida mai rubutun "Fiyayyen ɗalibi na shekara". Ta ce wa sauran yaran, "Fiyayyen ɗalibi ba wanda ya fi kowa gani ba ne, sai wanda ya fi kowa ƙoƙari."

Tambayoyi:
Wane aiki Malama Bushra ta yi kafin ta yi ritaya?
Ta yi aikin malanta a wata makarantar firamare a Yola.
Me almajiran suke yi bayan karatun alfijir?
Da yawansu sukan yi gararamba a titi suna bara.
Wace tawaya Hilal yake da ita?
Ba ya gani sosai sai idan ya kawo littafi kusa da fuskarsa.
Me Malama Bushra ta ce game da nahawu?
Ta ce nahawu shi ne tsarin harshe.
Me ya sa mafarauta suke kashe karkanda?
Suna kashe ta saboda ƙahonta.

lessons.title: Matsafi a yanar gizo
lessons.summary: Abdulmatin in Bauchi watches videos of a rich, haughty sorcerer who sells charms online and claims he can call back the souls of the dead; Malam Ghazali, the imam, tells him that trusting such things is shirk and tells a story of a sorcerer who failed before a carcass; Abdulmatin keeps his money and his faith.
lessons.text:
Abdulmatin matashi ne a Bauchi. Yana aikin gyaran wayoyi a kasuwa, amma kasuwancinsa ba ya tafiya sosai. Wata rana yana kallon bidiyo a wayarsa, sai ya ga wani matsafi yana magana.

Matsafin yana zaune a kan kujera mai tsada, yana sanye da zobba na zinariya. Yana magana da gadara, yana cewa, "Ni ba kamar sauran mutane ba ne. Ku dubi motocina da gidajena! Duk wanda ya sayi layata, arziki zai bi shi." Gadarar da yake nunawa ta sa mutane da yawa sun yarda da shi. Ya ƙara da cewa yana iya kiran kurwar mutumin da ya mutu, ya yi magana da ita. "Kurwa ba ta mutuwa," in ji shi, "kuma ni ina iya kiranta."

Abdulmatin ya so ya sayi layar. Kuɗin ya kai naira dubu hamsin, kuma za a tura su ta waya. Kafin ya tura, ya je wurin limamin masallacinsu, Malam Ghazali, domin ya ji ra'ayinsa.

Malam Ghazali ya saurare shi, sannan ya ce, "Ɗana, wannan laya abin wofi ce. Ba ta kawo arziki, ba ta hana talauci. Kada ka kashe kuɗinka a kan abin wofi. Kuma yarda cewa wani mutum yana da ikon da Allah kaɗai yake da shi, shirka ce. Shirka tana ɓata bangaskiyar mutum. Bangaskiyarka ita ce dukiyarka mafi girma: kada ka sayar da ita da naira dubu hamsin."

Sai malamin ya ce, "Bari in ba ka wata kissa. A zamanin da, akwai wani matsafi a wani gari da ya ce yana iya tayar da wanda ya mutu. Sarkin garin ya ce a kawo masa mushen wani jaki da ya mutu a bakin kasuwa. Matsafin ya yi ta karanta abubuwa, yana busa hayaƙi a kan mushen, yana kiran kurwar jakin. Ya yi haka daga safe har yamma. Mushen bai motsa ba. Daga ƙarshe sai ƙuda suka taru a kan mushen, mutane suka fara dariya. Matsafin ya ɗauki kayansa ya gudu daga garin."

Abdulmatin ya yi dariya. Malamin ya ci gaba da cewa, "Abin da wannan kissa take koya mana shi ne: matsafi yana sayar da magana ne kawai. Gadararsa da motocinsa daga kuɗin mutane irinka suka fito. Gadara ba ta da amfani a gaban Allah. Idan kana son arziki, ka yi aiki da gaskiya, ka koyi sabuwar fasaha, ka roƙi Allah."

Abdulmatin bai tura kuɗin ba. Maimakon haka, ya yi amfani da su ya koyi gyaran kwamfutoci. Bayan wata shida, aka kama matsafin a Abuja saboda damfara. Abdulmatin ya tuna da kissar mushen jaki, ya ce, "Na gode wa Allah da bai bar ni na sayar da bangaskiyata ba."

Tambayoyi:
Me matsafin yake sayarwa a yanar gizo?
Yana sayar da laya, yana cewa arziki zai bi duk wanda ya saye ta.
Me Malam Ghazali ya ce game da yarda da matsafi?
Ya ce shirka ce, kuma tana ɓata bangaskiyar mutum.
Me sarkin garin ya ce a kawo wa matsafin a cikin kissar?
Ya ce a kawo masa mushen wani jaki.
Me ya faru da mushen jakin?
Mushen bai motsa ba, sai ƙuda suka taru a kansa.
Me Abdulmatin ya yi da kuɗinsa?
Ya koyi gyaran kwamfutoci da su.

lessons.title: Kyamara a sama
lessons.summary: In Borno, Captain Babale's battalion, in khaki, uses a small camera aircraft to find the landmines bad elements had buried on the road to Falmata's village, which the fighters destroyed; the mines are cleared, the government rebuilds, and the villagers are resettled in their homes.
lessons.text:
Kyaftin Babale yana cikin wata bataliya ta sojoji a Borno. Aikin bataliyarsu shi ne kare hanyoyi da ƙauyuka a kusa da Maiduguri. Sojojin bataliyar suna sanye da kayan khaki, kuma motocinsu ma launin khaki ne.

Shekara uku da suka wuce, 'yan ta'adda sun kai hari a ƙauyen su Falmata. Sun ruguza gidaje, sun ruguza makaranta da masallaci, sun ƙone rumbunan hatsi. Ƙauyawan suka gudu zuwa sansanin 'yan gudun hijira a Maiduguri. Falmata da 'ya'yanta uku suna zaune a cikin tanti tun lokacin.

A bana gwamnati ta ce za a mayar da ƙauyawan gidajensu. Amma akwai matsala babba: an ji labari cewa 'yan ta'addan sun binne nakiya da yawa a kan hanyar ƙauyen kafin su gudu. Wasu ɓaragurbin matasa daga yankin ne suka taimaka musu, suka nuna musu inda za su ɓoye nakiyar. Daga baya sojoji sun kama waɗannan ɓaragurbin matasa, amma ba su faɗi inda kowace nakiya take ba.

Sai aka kawo wa bataliyar wani sabon kayan aiki: ƙaramin jirgi mai kyamara da ake tuƙawa daga ƙasa. Kyaftin Babale ya tashi jirgin a sama da hanyar. Kyamarar jirgin tana iya ganin inda aka tona ƙasa kwanan nan, da wayoyin da ke fitowa daga cikin ƙasa. Bayan kwana biyu, sun gano nakiya goma sha ɗaya a kan hanyar.

Sojoji masu ƙwarewa suka tafi wuraren a hankali, suka tono kowace nakiya, suka kai ta nesa, suka tayar da ita. Kowane lokacin da aka tayar da nakiya, sai ƙasa ta girgiza. Kyaftin Babale ya ce wa sojojinsa, "Kowace nakiya da muka cire, rai ce muka ceto."

Bayan an tsabtace hanyar, gwamnati ta fara gina sababbin gidaje a madadin waɗanda aka ruguza. Bayan wata biyar, aka fara tsugunar da ƙauyawan a ƙauyensu. Motocin khaki na bataliyar suka raka motocin da ke ɗauke da ƙauyawa da kayansu.

Da Falmata ta sauka a ƙauyen, ta durƙusa ta taɓa ƙasa. Ta ce wa Kyaftin Babale, "Na zaci ba zan sake ganin ƙauyena ba. Na gode muku da kuka tsugunar da mu a gidajenmu." Kyaftin ya ce, "Kada ki gode mana kaɗai. Ki gode wa wannan ƙaramin jirgi ma. Idonsa ya fi namu kaifi."

Tambayoyi:
Wane launi ne kayan sojojin bataliyar?
Kayansu launin khaki ne.
Me 'yan ta'adda suka yi a ƙauyen su Falmata?
Sun ruguza gidaje, makaranta da masallaci, sun ƙone rumbunan hatsi.
Su wane ne suka taimaka wa 'yan ta'adda su ɓoye nakiya?
Wasu ɓaragurbin matasa daga yankin ne suka taimaka musu.
Ta yaya bataliyar ta gano nakiyar?
Ta yi amfani da ƙaramin jirgi mai kyamara.
Me gwamnati ta yi bayan an tsabtace hanyar?
Ta gina sababbin gidaje, ta tsugunar da ƙauyawan a ƙauyensu.

lessons.title: Kyamarar mahaɗar titi
lessons.summary: In Accra, Tasiru, a drunkard, drives home at night and knocks down a motorcyclist; an eyewitness, Abena, and the camera at the junction show the court what happened; his lawyer argues the law, the judge sentences him to house arrest with treatment, and the drinking that had tied up his life loosens its grip.
lessons.text:
Tasiru yana zaune a zango a Accra, a ƙasar Ghana. Yana da shagon sayar da kayan mota, amma tun da matarsa ta rasu, ya fara shan giya. Da shigewar lokaci ya zama mashayi: kowane dare sai ya sha, kuma da safe ba ya iya buɗe shagonsa da wuri. Matsalar giyar ta yi masa dabaibayi: kasuwancinsa ya lalace, abokansa sun guje shi.

Wani dare Tasiru ya fito daga gidan giya ƙarfe ɗaya na dare, ya shiga motarsa. A wata mahaɗar titi, bai tsaya a jan haske ba, ya bugi wani mai babur. Mai babur ɗin ya faɗi, ƙafarsa ta karye. Tasiru ya tsorata, bai tsaya ba, ya gudu.

Amma akwai ganau. Wata mata mai suna Abena tana tsaye a bakin titi tana jiran mota. Ta ga komai. Ta kira 'yan sanda, ta faɗa musu launin motar da kuma wani ɓangare na lambarta. Kuma a wannan mahaɗa akwai kyamarar da gwamnati ta kafa don lura da hanya. Kyamarar ta ɗauki motar Tasiru a lokacin da ya ƙi tsayawa a jan haske.

Washegari 'yan sanda suka zo shagon Tasiru suka kama shi. Aka kai shi kotu. A gaban alƙali, Abena ta tsaya a matsayin ganau, ta faɗi abin da ta gani. Sannan aka nuna bidiyon kyamarar. Lauyan gwamnati ya ce, "Ganau ɗaya da bidiyo ɗaya sun isa. A shari'ance, babu shakka game da laifin."

Lauyan Tasiru ya tashi ya ce, "A shari'ance, wanda ya amsa laifinsa da kansa, kuma ya biya kuɗin maganin wanda ya ji wa rauni, ana iya rage masa hukunci." Tasiru ya amsa laifinsa, ya nemi gafara a gaban mai babur ɗin da iyalansa, ya yi alƙawarin biyan kuɗin asibitinsa.

Alƙalin ya yanke masa hukuncin ɗaurin talala na shekara ɗaya. Aka sa masa wata na'ura a ƙafa da take nuna wa 'yan sanda inda yake a kowane lokaci. A lokacin talalar, ba zai iya fita daga gidansa ba sai zuwa shago da asibiti. Alƙalin ya kuma ce dole ne ya je asibiti kowane mako domin a taimaka masa ya daina giya.

Talalar ta zama alheri ga Tasiru. Bayan wata shida, ya daina shan giya. Ya ce wa wani abokinsa, "Na'urar da ke ƙafata ta ɗaure ni, amma ta kwance dabaibayin da giya ta yi mini. Yanzu ba ni mashayi ba ne." Ya kuma aika wa Abena saƙon godiya, domin da ba don wannan ganau ba, da bai canza ba.

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa kasuwancin Tasiru ya lalace?
Domin ya zama mashayi, matsalar giya ta yi masa dabaibayi.
Me Tasiru ya yi bayan ya bugi mai babur?
Bai tsaya ba, ya gudu.
Wa ya zama ganau a kotu?
Abena ce ta zama ganau.
Me lauyan gwamnati ya ce a shari'ance?
Ya ce a shari'ance babu shakka game da laifin.
Wane hukunci alƙalin ya yanke wa Tasiru?
Ya yanke masa hukuncin ɗaurin talala na shekara ɗaya.
Yaya rayuwar Tasiru take bayan wata shida?
Ya daina shan giya, kuma shi ba mashayi ba ne yanzu.

lessons.title: Girbi kafin ruwa
lessons.summary: Babagana, a farmer near Gombe, sees on a weather app that two storms are coming with one dry day right between them; he and his workers harvest the maize in that one day, his wife cooks taushe soup for them, and he brings the last load in before the rain can catch up with them, to everyone's relief.
lessons.text:
Babagana manomi ne a wani ƙauye kusa da Gombe. Yana da gonar masara babba. A bana masarar ta yi kyau sosai, kuma lokacin girba ya yi. Babagana ya shirya zai girba masararsa a makon gaba.

Ɗansa da yake karatu a jami'a ya sa masa wata manhaja ta yanayi a wayarsa. Manhajar tana nuna yadda yanayi zai kasance a kowace rana. Da safiyar Litinin, Babagana ya duba wayar. Manhajar ta nuna cewa ruwan sama mai ƙarfi zai sauka a ranar Talata da kuma ranar Alhamis. A tsakankanin ruwan biyu, ranar Laraba kaɗai za ta bushe.

Babagana ya damu. Idan ruwan ya sami masarar a cikin gona bayan ta bushe, za ta ruɓe. Ya ce wa matarsa, "Dole ne mu girba duk masarar a ranar Laraba, a tsakankanin ruwan Talata da na Alhamis. Rana ɗaya kawai muke da ita."

Ya kira samarin ƙauyen guda goma, ya yi musu alƙawarin biya mai kyau. Matarsa ta ce, "Ni kuma zan dafa musu tuwo da miyar taushe. Miyar taushe tana ba ma'aikata ƙarfi." Ta tafi kasuwa ta sayi ganyen kabewa, gyaɗa da nama.

Ranar Talata ruwan sama ya sauka kamar yadda manhajar ta ce. Ranar Laraba kuma rana ta fito tun asuba. Babagana da samarin suka shiga gona, suka fara girba. Suna yanke masarar, suna zuba ta a buhu, suna ɗora buhunan a kan amalanke.

Da rana, matar Babagana ta kawo tuwo da miyar taushe a gona. Samarin suka zauna a ƙarƙashin bishiya suka ci. Ɗaya ya ce, "Wannan taushe ta fi ta kowace mata a ƙauyen nan!" Kowa ya yi dariya, suka koma aiki.

Da yamma, sai gajimare baƙaƙe suka fara taruwa daga gabas. Babagana ya duba wayarsa: manhajar ta ce ruwan Alhamis zai fara da daddare, kafin lokacin da ta faɗa da farko. Ya ce wa samarin, "Mu yi sauri, kada ruwan ya riski masarar a waje!" Suka yi ta gudu da buhunan zuwa rumbu.

Suna ɗora buhu na ƙarshe a cikin rumbu, sai digon ruwa na farko ya faɗo. Ruwan bai riski ko buhu ɗaya ba. Babagana ya ji wata babbar sa'ida a zuciyarsa. Ya zauna a ƙofar rumbu yana numfashi. Matarsa ta ce, "Ka sami sa'ida yanzu?" Ya ce, "Na sami sa'ida, kuma na koyi abu: wayar nan ta fi tsofaffin alamomin da muke kallo a sama."

Tambayoyi:
Me Babagana yake shirin girba?
Yana shirin girba masararsa.
Wace rana ce a tsakankanin ruwan biyu?
Ranar Laraba ce.
Me manhajar yanayi ta nuna?
Ta nuna cewa ruwan sama zai sauka ranar Talata da Alhamis, ranar Laraba kaɗai za ta bushe.
Wane abinci matar Babagana ta dafa wa ma'aikata?
Ta dafa musu tuwo da miyar taushe.
Me ya sa Babagana ya ce su yi sauri da yamma?
Domin kada ruwan ya riski masarar a waje.
Yaya Babagana ya ji bayan an shigar da buhu na ƙarshe?
Ya ji babbar sa'ida a zuciyarsa.
